dark_bracket.basis: Wayback captures of avantgardefusionnyc.com (still at 167 Mott) and ksrny.com/listing/167-mott-street (listed, possession immediate)
dark_bracket.caveat: That the listed space is the AvantGarde Fusion shopfront is inferred: the other shopfront, Wick and Pour, is open. Not confirmed at the door.

listing.broker: Meridian Retail Leasing (moved from KSR, Kassin Sabbagh Realty, October 2026)

timeline.what: Deed, Rose Luca to Virginia Young. Young family holds until 2013 (estates 2001, 2005; Sophie Von Young Enterprise LLC 2008).
Ritual Archive opens, outlet of Ritual Vintage (377 Broome). Reviewed by Time Out 27 Sept 2013. Closed, date not found.
Sold for $8,500,000 to 167 Mott Street LLC.
DOB Alt-2: minor exterior renovation of existing commercial storefronts and residential entrance. Signed off.
Sold for $17,000,000 to 167 Mott LLC, the current owner.
Hemp Garden (CBD) opens, its fourth NYC location. Closed, date not found.
DOF storefront registry: two premises (retail, other), both filed not vacant on 12/31. No filings for this lot after the 2020-21 year.
AvantGarde Fusion established at 167 Mott (its own claim).
Eight 311 commercial noise complaints at the address (loud music/party, store). Tenant's site lists in-store events Oct, Nov, Dec 2024.
Sidewalk shed permit (DOB NOW, MNK Enterprises). Facade violation open since 2025-06-09.
Last capture of AvantGarde Fusion's site giving 167 Mott; pop-ups Apr-Jun 2025.
KSR listing captured: 550 sf ground + 550 basement, possession immediate.
AvantGarde Fusion 'now located at 207 Bowery'. KSR page Not Found. Wick and Pour (candle studio) open at 167 Mott daily 12-10, 217 Yelp reviews.
Listing moves to Meridian Retail Leasing: 600 sf plus basement, white-box delivery, asking $6,750 a month, reduced from $7,000.
